measurement.valuation: marked gross invested assets before pending trades
measurement.charge_date: last observed common NAV in each calendar quarter
measurement.proration: inclusive calendar days; opening/closing stubs use declared data endpoints
measurement.payment: borrowed exposure: add to debt; unlevered: proportional asset sale including original costs
measurement.ordering: mark and accrue funding, charge custody, execute prior signal, form next signal
measurement.private_base: CHF50 quarterly capped-bracket simplification at this capital scale
measurement.fee_type: current-tariff hypothetical sensitivity; no administration-fee revenue

source.role: Preserved generic current-tariff evidence, not historical invoices or negotiated account terms.

interpretation.scope: 32 independent full-period paths: old 24 comparisons plus eight absolute-factor cases. Main no-custody baseline unchanged.
interpretation.pricing: Private full-value versus excess-only threshold interpretations both retained. Legal entity is a separate scenario, not a selected legal form or confirmed quote.
interpretation.fx: Original frozen baseline CHF conversion; no historical tariff/FX/VAT reconstruction.
interpretation.ordering: Quarterly expense changes equity/debt before prior-signal execution and next-signal formation; expense can change band crossings and subsequent trades.
interpretation.nonmonotonic: Fees can alter intervention timing; endpoint returns need not be monotonic in costs. A higher ending value does not make fees beneficial.
interpretation.business: Administration revenue, capital inflows, owner consumption and manager business costs remain separate.
interpretation.gap: Actual account classification, exact tariffs, fund eligibility and invoice-level implementation remain open.
